study: Buy the clean breakout on the book: when a name on the desk's book clears a resistance order block (0.10-0.30% above the top of a sell zone broken in the last 15 minutes, by the desk's own live reading), does buying it beat (a) a different book name at the same minute and (b) the same name later in the day, after the full spread?
registered_at: 2026-10-08 ~04:30 ET, before any session from 2026-10-08 on is scored and before the scoring tool exists
origin: Operator 10/5-10/7: 'break out from resistance is a profit run ... never buy going into resistance'; WMT 10/7 (brk +0.11%) prompted 'hopefully we are logging the SR to see how we can take advantage'. The desk logs ob_* on every book check since 10/6-10/7 (ai_reports/shadow.jsonl, ~97% coverage on 10/7), so breakouts the desk did NOT trade are now observable. Distinct from sr_breakout_forward_prereg.json (H1-H3: the desk's own FILLS only, which this does not replace).
prior: LOW. sr_breakout_history_prereg.json FAILED (6 weeks of minute data); SR levels 10/2: breaking resistance was the WORST of 7 S/R states; the 0.10-0.30% 'clean' band was the one better band in the 10/5 in-sample cells (not significant). 10/7 day review (information, seen before registration, excluded here): 3 clean events, -6.3 bp gross 15m.

data.signal: ai_reports/shadow.jsonl on the mini: every book check row (ts, symbol, source, price, ob_brk_dist_pct, ob_resist_0.3, ob_room_pct, ob_bars, spread_r). The breakout reading is the LIVE IEX one the desk sees (ob_observe.breakout_dist on the desk's 1-min IEX bars, blocks known by that minute). Rows without ob fields are counted and skipped, never imputed.
data.fills_and_outcomes: SIP trades and NBBO (Alpaca historical, after hours): never the shadow 'price' field (memory: shadow price inflates backtests).
data.sessions: every session from 2026-10-08 on (10/06-10/07 seen in development: excluded). Sessions with a desk restart between 09:45 and 15:30 are kept; book checks during a restart gap simply do not exist.

event.definition: a book check at time c, 09:45 <= c <= 15:30 ET, with 0.10 <= ob_brk_dist_pct < 0.30 (CLEAN), that is a NEW reading: the same symbol's latest check in [c-120 s, c) exists, carries the ob keys with ob_bars >= 30, and has ob_brk_dist_pct present-and-null or < 0.10 ('None' means the key is present with a null value; a missing key = no reading); ob_bars must not jump by more than 2 between that check and c (a store backfill, not a price move). A symbol with no check in the prior 120 s cannot produce an event (counted: covers restarts and fresh book entries). PRIMARY rows only: price_src 'quote' and arm_why not prefilter_far / tape_only. The logged distance is read on the ask: rebuild the block top as price / (1 + brk/100) and require the SIP NBBO MID at c to be >= 0.10% above it as well; events that are CLEAN on the ask but not on the mid are counted as 'spread_only' (information). PRIMARY = the first event per symbol per session; later events of the same symbol are information only.
event.entry: enter at c + 5 s (the row ts is the poll start; the ask is a REST read after it; REST age logged if available). Gross = SIP NBBO mid at entry to SIP NBBO mid at exit. Cost = half the full SIP spread at the entry quote + half at the exit quote, plus 1 cent round trip when price < $5. A quote older than 5 s at either end drops the event (counted), never cost 0.
event.exit: PRIMARY: the SIP NBBO mid at entry + 15 min (quote <= 5 s old); if halted (no SIP 1-min bars for >= 5 min covering the exit), the first quote after resume (counted).
event.groups: by the event row's source: TIGHT (source 'tight') and MOVERS (every other desk source). Scored and decided separately; pooled is information only.

controls.CONTROL_A_primary: cross-name, same minute: a random (seed 59, per event '59|SYM|c') OTHER symbol in the SAME group whose LATEST check in [c-30 s, c] carries ob keys (ob_bars >= 30) with ob_brk_dist_pct present-and-null and ob_resist_0.3 not True, the same PRIMARY row filters, and that was NOT itself an event in [c-15 min, c] (nothing after c is read). Same entry (c + 5 s), exit and cost. No candidate -> pair dropped (counted).
controls.CONTROL_B_secondary: same name, later: a random (seed 59) book check of the SAME symbol starting after the event's exit (entry + 15 min) and by 15:30, with ob_brk_dist_pct None; same entry/exit/cost. Never drawn before or during the event trade (the 10/06 hindsight-control artifact). No candidate -> dropped (counted). Information only.

statistic: per group: mean net15 of PRIMARY events (bp) and the paired mean of EVENT minus CONTROL_A; SE clustered by session; halves FIXED NOW by trading-calendar index of every NYSE session from 2026-10-08 (10/8 = 0 -> A, 10/9 = 1 -> B, alternating), whether or not a session produced events
power: before any mean, per group per half: n pairs, n sessions, SE; t_crit = Student-t one-sided at p 0.01255 (the 2.24 equivalent) with df = sessions with >= 1 pair - 1; MDE = (t_crit + 0.84) x SE. UNDERPOWERED while MDE > 15 bp (TIGHT) / > 40 bp (MOVERS), or < 60 pairs per half, or < 15 sessions per half. Up-front estimate (registration, from 10/7 only: 3 clean events on the whole book, ~1-2 per group per day): 60 pairs per half per group needs roughly 60-120 sessions, so 12/15 (~48 sessions) is UNLIKELY to be reached; the expected outcome at 12/15 is CLOSED UNPROVEN unless the event rate is much higher on fuller books.
pass: per group (Bonferroni 2): EVENT minus CONTROL_A >= +5 bp with session-clustered t >= t_crit pooled over both halves, positive in BOTH halves, AND EVENT net15 > 0 pooled, AND >= 60 pairs and >= 15 sessions per half, AND the contrast stays > 0 after dropping the top 3 sessions and (separately) the top 5 symbols by contribution. FAIL if the pooled paired t <= -2 at any read, OR if both halves meet the power bars and the group does not PASS. KNIFE-EDGE flag on a PASS if POKE and CHASE contrasts are both <= 0. Each group is read ONCE: when it meets the power bars, or on 2026-12-15, where anything still underpowered is CLOSED UNPROVEN. No information cell can be promoted. A PASS earns a pre-registered paper A/B of a breakout arm (skeptic first); nothing live changes by itself.
decision_date: weekly from 2026-10-15 the tool reports counts, sessions, SE and MDE only; it computes no means and writes the paired differences to a sealed file (ai_reports/sr_breakout_book/sealed.jsonl) read only at a group's single read
information_only: POKE and CHASE bands are always reported next to CLEAN, same rules
bands POKE (0 < brk < 0.10) and CHASE (brk >= 0.30), same rules, as separate cells
events split by ob_room_pct after the break (None = no resistance overhead vs > 0)
events split by %R state at c (fast %R rising over the prior 3 checks vs not), when the row carries pctr
events the desk actually bought within 5 min (and their realized round trips) vs not
session coverage: share of book checks carrying ob fields; events dropped by reason
spread_only events (CLEAN on the ask, not on the SIP mid)
non-first events per symbol per session
tool: tools/studies/sr_breakout_book.py (to be written; skeptic code review before it scores any session). Read-only: shadow.jsonl + Alpaca historical SIP after 16:30 ET. Added to scripts/nightly.sh as count-only until 2026-10-15.
no_retuning: the 0.10-0.30% band, the 'new reading' rule, 2 s latency, 15-min hold, controls, seeds, groups and bars are fixed here; any change is a new pre-registration
caveats: the breakout reading uses the port's order blocks on the desk's IEX bars; the operator's TradingView zones can differ (10/7 chart check: matched on liquid names, mismatched on thin premarket names)
book checks are not uniform in time (names enter and leave the book; check cadence varies)
the book itself is selected (names up on the day); both controls are book names, so the contrast is within the book
tight names move little in 15 minutes: the MDE bar for TIGHT is tighter and may take weeks to reach

integrity.code_pins: ob_observe.py at b763402 and tools/order_blocks.py at a70a56b (git short hashes at registration). If either file changes in a way that alters the reading, scoring stops; sessions after the change are a new study.
integrity.fetch_failures: Alpaca SIP fetch failures (incl. 429s) are counted by role (event vs control); any unrecovered failure flags the session; no name is dropped silently.
integrity.coverage: per session: share of book checks with ob keys; sessions under 80% are flagged (kept).

amended: 2026-10-08 ~05:00 ET, before any session was scored and before the tool existed: result-skeptic FIX FIRST (14 findings) applied in full: control look-ahead removed (exclusion window [c-15m, c]; control check in [c-30 s, c]); 'None' defined, backfill guard (ob_bars >= 30, jump <= 2, prior check within 120 s); quote-path rows only + mid-based distance re-check; entry c+5 s; mid-to-mid gross with half-spread both ends and 5 s quote staleness; FAIL / CLOSED UNPROVEN rules and one read per group; t df + 15 sessions per half + MDE (t_crit+0.84) x SE with an up-front feasibility statement; concentration drops; first event per symbol per session; calendar halves fixed now; code pins; no promotion of information cells + knife-edge flag; fetch-failure accounting; blind weekly runs with a sealed file.
